item.text: {"candidates":[{"query_id":"q05","reason":"Filtered aggregation retains qualifying counts; HAVING removes groups without qualifying rows while preserving NULL route keys and BIGINT counts.","sql":"SELECT PULocationID AS pickup, DOLocationID AS dropoff, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7) AS trips FROM trips GROUP BY PULocationID, DOLocationID HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7) > 0"},{"query_id":"q05","reason":"Window counting followed by DISTINCT produces one row per route, preserving duplicate counts, NULL keys, the original date predicate, and BIGINT counts.","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT PULocationID AS pickup, DOLocationID AS dropoff, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY PULocationID, DOLocationID) AS trips FROM trips WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7"}]}
